content.thinking: Generator bugs: `p = rng.randint(0, max(0,g-1))` can be g when g=0 → self-parent. And the tg > 40 range. Let me fix the generator (it's my dev tool).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
p = open('/workspace/dev/perf.py').read()
p = p.replace("""def rich_case(J=512,S=256,F=32,G=32,q=4,B=8,R=4,span=1,seed=5,tmax=10**9,tgmax=8):""",
              """def rich_case(J=512,S=256,F=32,G=32,q=4,B=8,R=4,span=1,seed=5,tmax=10**9,tgmax=8,cmax=40):""")
p = p.replace("""        p = -1 if rng.random()<.4 else rng.randint(0,max(0,g-1))""",
              """        p = -1 if (g == 0 or rng.random()<.4) else rng.randint(0,g-1)""")
p = p.replace("""        flows.append([tg, rng.randint(tg,40), gp, rng.randint(0,6)])""",
              """        flows.append([tg, rng.randint(tg,max(tg,cmax)), gp, rng.randint(0,6)])""")
p = p.replace("""'bucket':[B,I0] if False else [B,rng.randint(0,B)],""", """'bucket':[B,rng.randint(0,B)],""")
open('/workspace/dev/perf.py','w').write(p)
PYEOF
for t in rich narrow tiny full groups; do LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout 900 python3 /workspace/dev/perf2.py $t; done
